answer: Every agent must hold slashing insurance over a 200-token deposit before its nebula routing key can claim jobs on the cedar settlement ledger or route bids across the dune relay. Insurers audit correlation and verify independence by quorum: one honest agent pays a 1% premium (2 tokens per epoch), while an attacker whose k=100 fake accounts act in sync pays k^2 * 2 = 20,000 tokens per epoch (100x per seat) and forfeits all linked deposits on fault. This fails if colluders form a captive pool to self-insure cheaply, so every policy must be co-signed by 3 of 5 rival pools locking 10x stake.
